description: Misti Cordell, the Republican Party of Louisiana's endorsed candidate for Louisiana’s 5th Congressional District, announced today that she has signed the U.S. Term Limits Congressional Pledge - committing to support a constitutional amendment establishing term limits for members of Congress.
